Tests Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride(viewportMeta) affects layout width.
Initial clientWidth (mobile: false, default): 785
1. Mobile: false, viewportMeta: "enable"
clientWidth: 320
2. Mobile: false, viewportMeta: "default"
clientWidth: 785
3. Mobile: true, viewportMeta: "default"
clientWidth: 320
4. Mobile: true, viewportMeta: "enable"
clientWidth: 320
5. Defaulting when viewportMeta is omitted
mobile: false -> clientWidth: 785
mobile: true -> clientWidth: 320
